title: Pool protocol v1 message: offer_accept (router -> coordinator)
description: Phase 1 of two-phase dispatch (D-D2): the router commits to the offered job under a short lease. After accept, the router pulls the body via GET /pool/jobs/{job_id}/body (phase 2) and may abort it (body_abort).

job_id.description: Job id from the work_offer being accepted.

lease_ms.description: Short lease in ms: how long the router commits to this job (pull the body and start service) before the coordinator may treat the accept as expired and re-offer. Typical: 5000.

model_id.description: Which local model on this router will serve the job.

n_ctx.description: The member's real context window for that model (the coordinator uses it for the max_tokens clamp, D-C6).
